name: cautious
description: Default-ask. Only a short, explicit allowlist of clearly safe actions runs without confirmation. Best for unfamiliar codebases or your first week running an agent autonomously.

rules.reason: Blocked by guardrail cautious profile: destructive/irreversible command pattern.
Force push is blocked outright under the cautious profile.

rules.match: ^(git status|git diff|git log|ls|cat|pwd|echo|npm test|npm run lint|pytest)\b
rules.reason: Read-only or test command explicitly allowlisted.
